title: Variance process for industrial occupancy: F-1 classified as F-2 or addressed as similar risk
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: August 2026 (platform created August 14, 2026, last updated August 14, 2026)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies the variance application, review and enforcement process for AHJs and designers that may classify a high-hazard F-1 occupancy as medium-hazard F-2, or treat F-1 as similar risk to F-2.
An F-1 occupancy currently does not allow an attached restaurant or beverage establishment within the same building.
The Discussion reports that some AHJs rejected variance applications outright, and the STANDATA reaffirms the process to support consistency across Alberta.
The document states that it is not a design or evaluation guide for the required engineering analysis.
